scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
